verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents managed scraping, crawling, extraction and browser-action endpoints, plus a CLI and SDKs for calling them. There is no evidence of building, uploading or deploying custom serverless scraping scripts that run on the platform. Its preset interactions (click, wait, scroll) and its CLI or SDK calls are adjacent API features, not hosted custom code.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build and deploy custom serverless scraping scripts on the platform without managing my own infrastructure
